svg.title: Docling and Confluent Cloud — five ways into a stream
svg.desc: Five examples. 01: Docling for IBM watsonx, outside Confluent Cloud, streams chunks in. 02: a topic of URLs, converted by Docling called from Flink. 03: uploads to a private S3 bucket, converted the same way. All three feed the same shared enrichment (normalize, PII guard, dedup, quality gate) into enriched, quarantine and rejected topics. 04: invoices on a simulated clock, fields extracted by Docling, converted to EUR and aggregated into a live dashboard with lightning queries. 05: SEC filings as they are published, each report converted by Docling called from Flink, the financial figures extracted and turned into events.
svg.text: Five ways to get documents into a stream
Each example is one front door. Docling converts; Confluent Cloud for Apache Flink does the rest.
six months, on a sim clock
04 is the other shape: fields, not chunks
05 is a live feed: SEC filings, converted as they are published
